sentences.text: The reported events might simply be related to a change in air conditions in the ironing room.
Between 03:00 and 06:00, the humidity was observed at 46.2 %, which indicates that the air was drying out.
This observed reading was below the expected range of "49.0 % to 51.2 %".
It is probably just a normal fluctuation, as the humidity dropped below the predicted levels during the early morning.
